mision.jezero.paso1.desc: Your spaceship releases a satellite. It will circle Mars and map the ground for you.
mision.jezero.paso2.desc: Draw a path over Jezero Crater. Watch the battery and the signal to Earth: mapping costs both.
mision.jezero.paso3.desc: Compare the sites: flat ground, sunlight and natural protection. No site is perfect.
mision.jezero.paso4.desc: Pick two modules to build. Each one helps one gauge and costs another.
mision.jezero.paso5.desc: This storm really happened in May 2024, and the Curiosity rover measured it on Mars.
mision.jezero.paso6.desc: Two experts give you opposite advice, and Iris may be wrong. Check the gauges before you decide.
mision.jezero.paso7.desc: Point the antenna and send your data. Radio signals take minutes to cross between Mars and Earth.
mision.jezero.paso8.desc: See the chain of causes: which results came from your choices and which came from bad luck.
